extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, journalists, and policy analysts needing concise country political profiles
extracted.subtask_description: Structured reference entries summarizing each country's/current territory's chief of state, head of government, cabinet, election rules and recent election results. Intended as a concise political profile dataset for many countries and territories.

rubrics_metrics.name: chief of state
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typically lists the formal head of state (e.g., president, monarch, pope) with start date. Often includes representation notes (e.g., monarch represented by a governor or high commissioner) and occasionally notes when the president is both chief of state and head of government.

rubrics_metrics.name: head of government
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists the head of government (e.g., prime minister, president when also head of government) with start date. May include deputy prime ministers and notes about which ministries fall under presidential control vs prime minister (as in some entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: cabinet
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the executive/cabinet body (e.g., Council of Ministers, Cabinet, Executive Council), how members are appointed (by president, prime minister, approved by Parliament, etc.), and any special composition notes (e.g., number of commissioners for the European Commission, ex officio members).

rubrics_metrics.name: elections
rubrics_metrics.description: elections: [method of selection, term length, scheduling information]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the method for selecting leaders (popular vote, parliamentary/assembly election, electoral college, appointment by other body), term lengths, last election date and next expected date, and special procedural details (runoff rules, requirement for legislative supermajorities in early rounds, whether monarchy is hereditary, instances where president is chosen by an electoral assembly or by members of Parliament). Also includes exceptional cases (e.g., scheduled elections postponed or uncertain).

rubrics_metrics.name: election results
rubrics_metrics.description: election results: [who was elected and vote percentages or vote counts]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports the outcome of the most recent relevant election: name of winner(s), percent (or share) of vote, sometimes vote counts or parliamentary/delegate vote totals, and contextual comments (e.g., elections marred by fraud, runoffs, unopposed nominees). May include multiple-ballot details (first/second ballot tallies) and notes on abstentions or invalid ballots.

rubrics_metrics.name: notes / special provisions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional explanatory context such as constitutional provisions (term limits, powers of the president), coalition composition, extraordinary events (coups, interim governments), appointment peculiarities (e.g., president appoints prefect/high commissioner), or other country-specific details that clarify the political situation beyond the basic fields.
